d:
Bihar MLC Election Result : bihar vidhan parishad chunav ke natijon men patna snatak sit se JDU ke niraj kumar ne jit darj ki hai. vahin, kosi snatak sit par BJP ke enke yadav ne jit ki haitrik lagaee hai.
Bihar vidhan parishad ki 8 siton men se 6 siton ke natije samne aa chuke hain, jabki tirhut aur darbhanga siton ka rijalt aana baki bataya gaya hai.
Is bich anant sinh ke bayan ne bhi rajnitik charcha tej kar di hai. unhonne kaha ki unki narajgi parti se nahin, balki niraj kumar se hai.
